name: Itchy Dragon 81
author: Bastimans
description: Rounded amber button that scales up on hover.
howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes from #ffc600 to #000000, text color changes from #000000 to #ffc600, transform becomes scale(1.1).
combined:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Itchy Dragon 81</title>
<style>
/* Itchy Dragon 81 by Bastimans — https://uiverse.io/Bastimans/itchy-dragon-81 */
button {
  background-color: #ffc600;

  color: #000000;

  padding: 12px 24px;

  border: none;

  border-radius: 30px;

  font-size: 18px;

  font-weight: bold;

  cursor: pointer;

  text-shadow: 2px 2px 3px #ffc600;

  box-shadow: 2px 2px 3px #ffc600;

  transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out;

}

button:hover {
  background-color: #000000;

  color: #ffc600;

  transform: scale(1.1);

}

button:active {
  transform: scale(0.97);
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<button>Don't Click</button>

</body>
</html>
